title: Excessive battery usage with time / data growth
symptom: After two years, the phone battery lasts only about 10 hours, with AAPS accounting for more than 20% of battery usage. Purging AAPS data (about 1GB) restored battery life to 24 hours, but the issue persists for some users even after resetting databases.
cause: The thread suggests that data growth over time leads to excessive battery usage, but no definitive root cause is identified. One user notes that purging data helped, but others report it didn't help, so the cause is not fully established.
fix: Purging AAPS data and importing back settings helped one user, but it did not help others. The thread mentions that cleanup is available in 3.2 beta, but no specific fix is confirmed.
evidence_quote: After reading a post, that purging the AAPS data, could help with battery usage, I gave it a go. My AAPS user data storage use was reported at about 1GB. Purged it, imported back the settings and indeed, the AAPS is not first in the list anymore and phone battery now easily handles 24hrs again!
